summary: Executed backend + frontend regression for OCR/export/context-layer updates on public preview URL. Backend API suite passed (19/19) including OCR status/extract, region-only OCR, isolated Paddle fallback, export MIME+filename checks, and OCR text persistence on saved captures. Frontend OCR/export UI passed on desktop and mobile with one model-specific analysis failure and one clipboard graceful-handling issue.

ui_bugs.issue: Copy export buttons trigger unhandled browser clipboard permission error in console instead of fully graceful handling path.

integration_issues.flow: Upload -> OCR -> Run analysis using default GPT-5.5 model
integration_issues.issue: Analysis result did not render within 120-180s in repeated runs after OCR; switching model to Gemini 3.1 Pro produced immediate valid output.

action_items: Investigate GPT-5.5 analyze flow after OCR/image upload in web UI path; ensure done/error event is surfaced and user receives deterministic feedback.
Handle clipboard permission-denied errors gracefully in ExportBar copy actions (catch + toast message without uncaught page error).
Re-run quick UI regression after fixes on both default GPT model and Gemini model.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend writeClipboard() path does not guard navigator.clipboard permission failures; this leaks PAGE ERROR in browser mode.
Model-specific reliability gap exists in default GPT flow, while Gemini succeeds under same UI/context payload, suggesting provider-path handling inconsistency.
test_credentials: No auth flow required. /app/memory/test_credentials.md exists but contains no credentials.
seed_data_creation: Used synthetic OCR PNGs generated in pytest and existing non-blank local PNG/JPEG assets for browser upload tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend OCR/export regression is currently green (19 passed). Extension validation-results.json contains 7/7 successful real-site captures with screenshot_bytes > 10KB (min 14982). UI issue remains model-specific: GPT-5.5 path failed to show analysis result in repeated post-OCR runs, while Gemini path succeeded.
rca of the issue: RCA 1 (analysis): Repro by uploading a real nonblank image, running OCR, keeping default GPT-5.5 model, then clicking Run analysis. Result panel stayed without analysis content through timeout in repeated runs; same flow with Gemini model returned content quickly. Likely model/provider-path specific stream failure or unhandled SSE error branch. RCA 2 (clipboard): Export copy buttons in browser mode call navigator.clipboard.writeText without local catch in component flow, causing permission-denied PAGE ERROR under restricted clipboard permissions instead of user-facing graceful fallback.
